fieldValues.title: AI's share of the work cannot grow with trust
fieldValues.statement: Each stage is either done by the AI or done by a person, fixed when the protocol is written. There is no measured path for a stage to move from every output checked, to a sample checked, to trusted, so human and AI collaboration cannot widen as the AI proves itself, and cannot narrow again when it slips.
source_ref: srs-programme vignette 27a7396f (owner, 2026-11-27): "gradually increase the ability for AI and human collaboration"
remedy e589fc6d return_when (triage can sample once two thirds are kept)
